europe_now.title: Spain Imposes Three Days of Mourning After Deadly High-Speed Train Disaster
europe_now.summary: Spain has initiated three days of national mourning following a fatal high-speed train crash that resulted in at least 68 deaths and over 100 injuries. Ministers reported that the disaster occurred after a train was instructed to proceed in error, prompting widespread questions regarding national rail safety and political impacts.

europe_now.title: EU Natural Gas Prices Surge Past €100 for First Time Since 2022
europe_now.summary: European natural gas prices surpassed €100 for the first time since 2022, introducing renewed energy market pressures across the continent. This milestone highlights growing vulnerabilities in European energy supplies amid ongoing regional geopolitical tensions.

top_stories.title: EU and Canada Deepen Bilateral Relations
top_stories.summary: The European Union and Canada have dropped an associate membership plan in a mutual bid to strengthen bilateral cooperation. Officials are utilizing a critical window of opportunity to solidify their partnership.

top_stories.title: Controversy Over Border Force Surveillance Powers
top_stories.summary: European Union lawmakers have strongly criticized new border force powers that permit social media surveillance. This pushback highlights ongoing tensions between security measures and digital rights within the bloc.
